input.description: One synthetic, non-sensitive 12-base FASTQ read compressed with gzip.

assertions: adapter source SHA-256 values bind this record to the reviewed package candidate
exact bundle and plan digests matched
miniwdl semantic check passed before approval and before launch
the child environment inherited no ambient variables, fixed the local Docker socket, and bound the Docker Engine ID into the approved plan
Docker Swarm was already active and automatic initialization remained disabled
approved input was copied at its exact approved length to a safe run-owned path and hashed after a free-space check
opened input and executable descriptors resolved back to their approved Linux procfs paths and protected ancestor chains
miniwdl enforced the WDL memory declaration as a hard container limit
both output paths resolved inside the miniwdl run directory
the real LocalJobRegistry enforced the owner and exposed running then completed output states
LocalJobRegistry kill terminated a separate live miniwdl run through the DSH local subprocess provider and settled it as killed with SIGTERM
limitations: This record covers real miniwdl, DSH local subprocess, LocalJobRegistry read/kill/wait, Docker Swarm, FastQC, provenance, output inventory, and cancellation.
The LocalJobRegistry owner was a registered lightweight acceptance fixture rather than a model-driven DSH Agent loop; isolated-profile smoke tests cover plugin loading and public tool contracts.
Container egress isolation was not asserted.
